neighbours.label: the first piece ' sw' or ' ro' of swim and roam: moving freely through water or land (sw|am, ro|amed, ro|ve)
fire: Sea turtles swam past the divers near the reef.

Penguins swam in long lines under the ice.
Mammoths roamed Europe during the last ice age.
Otters swim along the river every morning.
quiet: Sea turtles laid eggs near the divers on the sand.
